newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sidel shares up on order book growth.
newsitem.headline: Sidel shares up on order book growth.

text.p: Share in French packaging equipment maker Sidel rose strongly on the Paris bouse on Monday as the market focused on a 23.7 percent rise in order book value rather than a drop in 1996 sales, traders said.
The stock was up 4.36 percent at 1031 GMT, at 416.5 francs.

The group said on Friday sales fell 15.8 percent in 1996 to 3.120 billion francs but said order book value rose 23.7 percent to 1.930 billion francs and that this confirmed its expectation of significant growth in 1997.
The group also said that the use in Australia of a Sidel machine to produce 50 cl bottles made of PET plastic for beer confirmed beer as a target market.
